title: 第386章 追查魔宗余孽第385章 突破金丹期四层
content_zh:
张昊宇出了空间，身形落回房间卧室。
他褪去一身修炼时的浮躁气息，躺倒在床上闭目养神，梳理突破金丹四层后暴涨的灵力，静静平复心绪。
休整片刻，他推开房门走到客厅。
父母正与龙老头、龙奶奶闲聊家常，言语舒缓，满是人间温情。
张昊宇缓步坐下，陪着几位长辈闲谈，耐心聆听日常琐事，褪去修行者的锋芒，只是家中晚辈。
时光悄然流转，很快到了放学钟点。
张昊宇起身驱车前往学校接两个小不点妹妹。
两个小丫头远远望见他的车子，立刻挥着小手奔跑过来，一上车便叽叽喳喳围在他身旁。
问东问西，趣事、课堂见闻源源不断，清脆的笑声填满车厢。
一行人回到宅院，没过多久，大妹妹张晓丽、弟弟小天和徒弟凌昊，相继由管家安排的车辆接送归来。
夕阳西垂之际，三姐张晓月与小小师妹韩亦菲结束一天工作，也踏入院门。
偌大的宅院一下子热闹起来，处处充满人声。
管家适时上前躬身禀报：“张少，晚餐已经备好。”
众人结伴走向宽敞餐厅。桌上菜式琳琅满目，比起午餐还要丰盛数分。
推杯换盏之声此起彼伏，能饮酒的长辈、男子举杯闲谈。
不饮酒的女人与孩子埋头享用佳肴，欢声笑语不绝于耳，一派阖家团圆的热闹景象。
酒足饭饱，众人在庭院凉亭小憩片刻。
家中一众修炼之人皆有作息规划，稍作歇息后，陆续各自返回自己房间运转功法潜心修炼。
张昊宇独自回到卧房，房门轻轻闭合。
他意念一动，施展瞬移，身影刹那间出现在浅水湾一号别墅大门之外。

下一刻，灵力流转周身，骨骼、皮肉悄然重塑，容貌快速蜕变。
十九岁的张昊宇消失不见，取而代之的是一名二十五六岁的青年男子。
黑发利落，眉眼深邃冷冽，周身再无半分普通人的模样。
取而代之的是沉沉的压迫感，如同蛰伏于暗影之中的深渊。
“阎望。”
“地狱组织唯一执掌者。”
他静静伫立在别墅大门前，深邃目光望向院内。
潘峰等人地狱组织骨干察觉到气息，心头一凛，快步上前，躬身低头，声音压得极低：
“老大”
阎望淡淡点头，嗓音低沉冰冷，和张昊宇平日里温和的语调判若两人。
漆黑的夜色笼罩浅水湾一号别墅，整片区域寂静无声，唯有别墅主楼灯火沉稳，透着属于地狱组织总部的肃穆与冷沉。
阎望立在门前，周身气场冰冷内敛，不怒自威。
面对躬身肃立的潘峰等几名核心骨干，他语气淡漠却带着不容置喙的绝对权威。
“传令情报组全员待命，深挖所有邪修汇合的隐秘据点，彻查魔宗残余势力分布。”
“重点锁定魔宗老祖的藏身行踪。”
他目光扫过几人，字字严厉：“记住，查到线索即刻秘密上报，任何人不得擅自轻举妄动、私自出手。
魔宗老魔重伤未愈却底蕴犹存，麾下邪修数量不明，贸然行动只会打草惊蛇，徒增伤亡。一切行动，等我统一号令。”
content_en:
Zhang Haoyu left the space and fell back into the bedroom.
He lost the impetuous atmosphere during his cultivation, lay down on the bed, closed his eyes and rested his mind, sorted out the spiritual power that had skyrocketed after breaking through the fourth level of the golden elixir, and calmed down his mind.
After resting for a moment, he opened the door and walked to the living room.
The parents were chatting with Old Man Long and Grandma Long about home affairs, their words were soothing and full of human warmth.
Zhang Haoyu sat down slowly, chatting with a few elders, patiently listening to daily trivial matters, losing his sharpness as a practitioner, and just being a junior in the family.
Time passed quietly, and soon it was time to finish school.
Zhang Haoyu got up and drove to school to pick up his two little sisters.
The two little girls saw his car from a distance and immediately ran over waving their little hands. They chattered around him as soon as they got in the car.
Asking questions, interesting stories and classroom experiences kept coming, and the crisp laughter filled the carriage.
The group of people returned to the house, and not long after, the eldest sister Zhang Xiaoli, the younger brother Xiaotian and the apprentice Ling Hao were picked up and returned by vehicles arranged by the housekeeper.
As the sun set in the west, the third sister Zhang Xiaoyue and the junior sister Han Yifei finished their work for the day and stepped into the courtyard.
The huge house suddenly became lively and full of people.
The butler stepped forward at the right time and bowed to report: "Master Zhang, dinner is ready."
Everyone walked together to the spacious restaurant. There is a wide variety of dishes on the table, which is much richer than lunch.
The sound of changing glasses was heard one after another, and the elders and men who could drink raised their glasses and chatted.
Women and children who do not drink alcohol enjoy the delicious food, and there is endless laughter and laughter, creating a lively scene of family reunion.
After having enough wine and food, everyone rested for a while in the courtyard pavilion.
All the cultivators in the family have a schedule. After taking a short rest, they will return to their rooms one after another to practice their exercises and practice with concentration.
Zhang Haoyu returned to the bedroom alone, and the door closed gently.
With a thought, he used teleportation, and his figure instantly appeared outside the gate of Villa No. 1 in Repulse Bay.
The next moment, spiritual power flows throughout the body, bones, skin and flesh are quietly reshaped, and the appearance changes rapidly.
Nineteen-year-old Zhang Haoyu disappeared and was replaced by a young man in his mid-twenties.
With neat black hair and deep and cold eyebrows, he no longer looked like an ordinary person.
What replaced it was a heavy sense of oppression, like an abyss dormant in the shadows.
"Yan Wang."
"The sole leader of the Hell Organization."
He stood quietly in front of the villa gate, looking deeply into the courtyard.
Pan Feng and other backbone members of the hell organization noticed the aura, and their hearts trembled. They quickly stepped forward, bowed their heads, and spoke in a very low voice:
"Boss"
Yan Wang nodded lightly, his voice was low and cold, completely different from Zhang Haoyu's usual gentle tone.
The dark night enveloped Villa No. 1 in Repulse Bay, and the entire area was silent. Only the main building of the villa was dimly lit, showing the solemnity and coldness of the hell organization's headquarters.
Yan Wang stood in front of the door, his aura cold and restrained, not angry and intimidating.
Facing Pan Feng and several other core members who were standing in solemn silence, his tone was indifferent but with absolute authority that could not be disputed.
"Order all members of the intelligence team to be on standby, dig deep into all the secret strongholds where evil cultivators gather, and thoroughly investigate the distribution of the remaining forces of the Demon Sect."
"Focus on the whereabouts of the ancestor of the Demon Sect."
He glanced at several people and said sternly: "Remember, if you find any clues, report them immediately and secretly. No one is allowed to act rashly or take action without permission.
The old devil from the Demon Sect has not recovered from his serious injuries but his secrets are still there. The number of evil cultivators under his command is unknown. Taking rash actions will only scare the enemy and increase casualties. All actions are subject to my unified command. "
